ModMetaData.name: Storyteller Tuner
ModMetaData.author: Bolek98
ModMetaData.description:
Edit the built-in difficulties and storytellers instead of making new ones.
Difficulties: pick any difficulty (also ones added by mods) and change every value – threat scale, big threats, mood, yields, diseases, quest rewards, aging and more. During a game you can also edit the current game's difficulty directly.
Storytellers: pick a storyteller (Cassandra, Phoebe, Randy or a modded one) and change its rhythm – days of calm and of threats, spacing between raids, incidents per cycle, how often Randy's random events come and their weights, how hard it keeps the colony at its size, adaptation days.
Changes are saved in the mod settings, apply to new and running games, and every difficulty or storyteller can be reset to its original values.
